# CallTechCare

> Sprinkler repair and installation, irrigation, and wireless cameras in Miami-Dade and Broward County, Florida. Free inspection. Same-day service within business hours. 1-year workmanship warranty when CallTechCare performs the work and provides the materials. Website: https://www.calltechcare.com — Phone: (786) 366-2729.
